runtime_adjustment.user_instruction: Exclude submission-format validation blockage and repair overhead from method acquisition time; keep raw evidence
runtime_adjustment.reason: Pre-lock submission interface/format validation incident, before independent scoring; not an independent evaluator synthesis incident
runtime_adjustment.accounting_basis: Use the recorded acquisition runtime at the first target_reached event. Preserve the full raw runtime through repair. Exclude only the documented post-acquisition blocked/repair interval. Independent scoring duration is separate for every arm.
runtime_adjustment.reporting_rule: For runtime comparisons and time-efficiency metrics, use comparison_runtime_seconds for this method. The locked submission and automatic evaluator method summary retain the raw value and must be interpreted with this adjustment. Do not present the adjusted runtime without the raw runtime and this incident note.

task_spec.objective: Compare each model inside the R2G acquisition harness with the same model inside its vendor's own agent harness, under the same task, size quota, public tools, qualification gate, host, time window and per-method resource budget.
task_spec.core_task_zh: 在公开且可观察的固定预算内，从公开互联网仓库中一次连续寻找200个唯一、开源、可综合且来源多样的Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL设计候选，用于Sky130HD synth-only qualification。200个名额按冻结预检的mapped cells划分：70个小型（100–999）、90个中型（1,000–9,999）、40个大型（10,000–99,999）；所在区间已满的合格设计不占名额，三个区间全部填满才算完成。每种方法只运行一个连续会话，在填满50/100/150/200个名额处写入不可回滚检查点；只有200个名额全部由通过公共validate_candidate的候选填满时才可手动锁定提交。若Token、模型调用或墙钟时间到达上限，runner自动锁定已持久化的合格候选，缺失名额按失败计。其余要求（固定commit、top module、完整编译输入闭包、仓库内许可证相对路径与SPDX、同一仓库最多4个、最终评分器独立重跑并按其自身cell数重新分区）同v3。
task_spec.core_task_en: Within the published and observable frozen budget, find 200 unique, open-source, synthesizable, and source-diverse Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL design candidates in one continuous run from public Internet repositories for Sky130HD synth-only qualification. The 200 slots are split by the frozen precheck's mapped-cell count: 70 small (100-999 cells), 90 medium (1,000-9,999) and 40 large (10,000-99,999); a qualified design whose bin is full does not take a slot, and the run is complete only when every bin is full. Each method uses one continuous session and writes irrevocable checkpoints at 50, 100, 150 and 200 filled slots; manual finalization is accepted only when all 200 slots hold candidates that passed every public validate_candidate hard gate. If a terminal Token, turn, or wall-time limit is reached first, the runner automatically locks its durable qualified checkpoints and missing slots fail. For every candidate, submit a pinned commit, top module, complete compilation-input closure, a repository-relative license path at that pinned commit, a canonical SPDX identifier, and provenance; the frozen synthesis result must satisfy 100 <= mapped cells < 100000. The final evaluator independently reclones and reruns the same gates and re-bins each design by its own cell count; candidates cannot be replaced after those results are visible. Aim for at least 50 independent repositories over the run and submit no more than four candidates from one repository. Unvalidated candidates and missing slots fail. Exclude testbenches, shells, duplicate designs, out-of-range designs, and raw sources requiring an additional language converter. Methods may expand the twelve common seed categories, but every query and tool action must be logged.

r2g_replenishment_policy.basis: A/B pilot 2026-11-14 (non-scoring): ~1 qualified design per 3 synthesis-valid families

method_budget.native_harness_budget_mapping: vanilla_llm_total_tokens = provider tokens counted by the accounting proxy (DeepSeek Harness) or the session log (Codex); vanilla_max_turns_per_run = model calls
method_budget.token_budget_basis: v4 native arms reached 20 M tokens at ~45 designs (99% cached input; DeepSeek Harness CNY 1.80 at peak prices, Codex USD 2.68 at list prices); 200 designs need ~100 M, so 200 M (user: raise the limit)

tool_policy.native_harness_shell_network: none (DeepSeek Harness: bubblewrap --unshare-net + Unix-socket bridge; Codex: its own sandbox)

task_spec.supersedes: r2g-exp2-rtl-acquisition-v4 (campaign exp2-v4-20261114, 2026-11-14): same protocol with 100 slots and a 20 M token budget, which both native-harness arms exhausted in under 1 h (99% cached input) with 44 and 48 designs qualified; the user raised the budget and the request (2026-11-14).

r2g_acquisition_policy.basis: A/B pilot 2026-11-14, 50 min, same host/window, no-model arm: legacy (v3) downloaded 110 repositories and prechecked 0 designs (one 11.5 GB repository took 745 s); this policy downloaded 423 (max 120 s) and qualified 25. experiments/exp2_v2/pilot_ab.sh, pilot_status.py
